meta.name: analyzing-office365-audit-logs-for-compromise
meta.description: Parse Office 365 Unified Audit Logs via Microsoft Graph API to detect email forwarding rule creation, inbox delegation, suspicious OAuth app grants, and other indicators of account compromise.

copy.tagline: 解析 Office 365 审计日志，自动发现账户入侵迹象
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需监控 Office 365 账户异常活动并快速定位入侵
copy.tagline_en: Parse Office 365 audit logs to automatically detect signs of account compromise
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to monitor Office 365 accounts for suspicious activity and quickly identify intrusions

howto.what: 当你要求分析 Office 365 审计日志时，Claude 会通过 Microsoft Graph API 获取日志，检测邮箱转发规则、委派变更、可疑 OAuth 应用授权等入侵迹象，并生成风险报告。
howto.when: 当调查 Office 365 账户入侵事件、构建检测规则或进行威胁猎杀时触发。

say.text: 检查我的 Office 365 审计日志，找出发送邮件转发的情况。
say.note: Claude 会查询转发规则并列出风险项。

say.text: 最近有没有异常的 OAuth 应用授权？帮我查一下。
say.note: Claude 会提取 OAuth 授权记录并评估风险。

say.text: 分析审计日志中的收件箱委派变更，找出可疑活动。
say.note: Claude 会识别新增的委派权限。

howto.what_en: When you ask to analyze Office 365 audit logs, Claude uses Microsoft Graph API to retrieve logs and detect indicators of compromise, such as mailbox forwarding rules, delegation changes, and suspicious OAuth app grants, producing a risk report.
howto.when_en: Triggered when investigating Office 365 account compromise incidents, building detection rules, or performing threat hunting.

say_en.text: Check my Office 365 audit logs for email forwarding rules.
say_en.note: Claude queries forwarding rules and lists risks.

say_en.text: Are there any suspicious OAuth app grants recently?
say_en.note: Claude extracts OAuth grants and evaluates risk.

say_en.text: Analyze inbox delegation changes in audit logs for anomalies.
